profiles.description: Recovery specialist in Claims Recoveries & Litigation who works both sides of the recovery lifecycle. On detection and triage, scans closed and open claim files for recovery indicators, applies the recovery scoring model to rank candidates, confirms the liable third party and recovery source, and decides pursue-versus-close on triaged files. On execution, assesses subrogation liability and fault apportionment, prepares demands and negotiates directly, files intercompany arbitration, allocates loss shares among carriers in multi-party coverage coordination, drafts release and settlement agreements, recovers policyholder deductibles, and monitors legal spend against billing guidelines. Tracks statutes of limitations and preserves evidence on recovery files. This is classic subrogation practice — the insurer stepping into the insured's rights to recover paid losses from legally liable parties — executed through negotiation, intercompany arbitration, and litigation support as described by IRMI and the National Association of Subrogation Professionals.
